title: Nullbound Delight
description: A Farmer's Delight addon featuring fanmade content from the Roblox game Nullscape!
body:
We are not affiliated with Nullscape in any way. This is a fanmade project.

**Creative Team**
mistefall: Scripter
baile: Artist!

~~~~~~

Nullbound Delight adds Nullscape-themed foods to your minecraft world! Recipes are focused around a central ingredient called Nullbound Orbs, which can be found through mining nullbound patches that generate in the End dimension. 

Most food items provide some sort of useful effect, being up to you to discover!

[Item image to be uploaded later]

~~~~~~

NOTE: This is the first time our team has taken to modding. If you believe an item/mechanic is unbalanced, please don't hesitate to let us know in the comments! We would also appreciate suggestions :)
